relevance_note: Cohort of 14 HCM patients requiring heart transplantation, three with individually tabulated LAMP2 variants: "In three female patients, genetic testing revealed Danon disease (LAMP2)".
method_note: Read by hand; a short script assembled the JSON and cut row prefixes from Table 2 for spans (checked against the table). Scope: only P.8, P.9, P.10 (LAMP2) plus two relatives named in Table 2's Family History column (P.9 grandmother, SCD at 53; P.10 mother, HF, SCD at 60); other 11 cohort patients (other genes) get no rows. Labels: the text uses 'P.8–P.10' and 'Patient 9'; Table 2's 'Patient, Sex' column gives '8 F' etc.; used P.8/P.9/P.10. Table 2 columns: Patient, Sex | Gene | GRCh38 Position and Nomenclature | Variant Type | Rs, MAF%, Literature Reference | Zygosity, ClinGen Evaluation | ACMG Class | Gene Panel | Age at Diagnosis | Age at HT | Initial Echo | Family History. Age at Diagnosis has no printed unit; years assumed for ISO conversion. Age at HT recorded in treatment_summary, not as last evaluation. 'ClinGen Evaluation' (definitive) is a gene-disease rating, not recorded as variant pathogenicity; ACMG Class (LP/P) used. Literature reference [17] in P.10's variant cell refers to a prior report of the variant, not of this patient, so source_reference_in_review left 'not reported'. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true for the ALPK3 patient (P.3, out of scope), not the LAMP2 patients. cDNA strings printed in unusual form (c.T2C, c.G865-1C, c.G962GA) kept verbatim. Variant type 'Start-loss' recorded as 'other'. Group statements used: whole-cohort HCM, end-stage HF, 'all patients had documented high-grade ventricular arrhythmias', 'No patient had evidence of LV outflow tract obstruction at presentation', 'None had concomitant coronary artery disease or diabetes', dilated subgroup including all Danon patients, myocarditis in patients with LAMP2 variants, and 'none of the women with Danon disease showed evidence of multisystem involvement (skeletal muscle, liver, or nervous system)'; the last excludes skeletal myopathy, cognitive impairment, elevated liver enzymes and hepatomegaly on the checklist (CK, psychiatric and retinal items left not reported). 'High-grade ventricular arrhythmias' not mapped to the VT/VF checklist item (unspecified type). Table 1 counts (AF 6/10, RV hypertrophy, hypertrabeculation, liver fibrosis 0) exclude/assign no one. No stacked cells. No contradictions found.
